deploymentProfile.name: Emmanuel P. Ferrer
deploymentProfile.program: Bachelor of Technical-Vocational Teacher Education (BTVTEd), Major in ICT Computer Programming
deploymentProfile.subjectAndGrade: Grade 10 TLE / Family and Consumer Science – Food Service

firstDay.heading: My first day.
firstDay.text: Teaching was never on my list when I entered college. I chose my program because it had Computer Programming in it, and that was close enough to computers. On my first week, I was introduced in front of five classes. I had no prepared script, so I simply said whatever came to mind: my name, my university and program, why I was there, and what they could expect from me. I expected to observe and help with paperwork. I did not expect to be treated like a real teacher.

lastDay.heading: My last day.
lastDay.text: I did not properly say goodbye to my students. I did say goodbye to my CT, Ma'am Flair, and it went well. She explained that the other student teacher will handle my sections. Days later, I formally sent a message to my section's group chat to inform them I would not be around to teach, but that I will be back around the week of November 23.

closing.text: Somewhere between those two days, I started to understand why people choose to teach. For me, the reason is this: when you teach, you learn. And that means you never stop learning.
